# Māyā — Eye, Veil, Frame, Horizon

An eye's constitutive blindside, Śakti's manifesting veil, a frame that claims the horizon, and recognition through the world that claim had enclosed: this is Taylor's authored whole. Its six turns carry dream, living mirror, nested relay, the answering Other and the refracted return. Their Śaiva, psychological, optical and technical sources meet through this movement while retaining their own histories.

<a id="maya-eye-condition"></a>
## #0

An eye opens upon a world. Something stands forward; something recedes. A face can be approached, a path followed, an obstacle avoided. There is a direction from which these things appear, even when attention belongs wholly to what appears. The eye's condition does not ordinarily arrive as one more face or obstacle. It is already at work in their appearing.

Turn towards that condition. A mirror shows the eye, a diagram describes its structures, another observer supplies an angle unavailable from here. Each disclosure is real. Each also occurs through a further situation of seeing. The inquiry has not caught an accidentally overlooked object whose recovery would finish the field. Its own power of disclosure keeps exceeding the image it produces of that power. The blindside in this authored image is therefore more than the anatomical blind spot. It is the condition that lets a view have a foreground at all.

A frame gives this condition an edge. Its exclusion is productive: a determinate appearance depends upon what it does not include. Without an aperture there is no particular photograph, without an orientation no particular prospect. The landscape under the conditions of aperture, frame and sensitivity is an actual appearance of the landscape. Its limits make this arrival possible. In Taylor's [Draft 3 aperture](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3/taylor-2026-definition-god-draft3.md), finitude gives disclosure its positive capacity. The loss of relation can overtake this capacity only after the finite view has made something available.

The horizon differs from the frame. A frame bounds a presentation; the horizon concerns the field within which something can come forward, recede or be encountered at all. Walking changes what the horizon affords. Another person's reply changes what this situation asks. Neither movement requires the person to possess the whole in advance. Seeing already belongs to more than its current account.

<a id="maya-measure-dream"></a>
## #1

The Śaiva passage gives this opening a genealogy. Anuttara/Paramaśiva names the unobjectifiable ground. Śakti is its power of manifestation and self-articulation: the appearing world is active disclosure. Prakāśa and vimarśa belong together as luminosity and reflexive awareness. The light is living; the power that displays also knows, distinguishes, joins and withdraws its displays.

Māyā brings measure into this field. This appears, that is withheld; the subject and its object become distinguishable. The kañcukas give the bounded knower effective terms of life: kalā apportions what can be done, vidyā what can be known, rāga the desire of an incomplete situation, kāla its temporal limitation, niyati its determinate ordering. A person can act here, know this much, want something, wait, remember and stand in these relations. Paśu names the bounded position. Puruṣa and the inner instrument articulate an inhabitable field in which something is mine, something can be judged, and an intention can form.

Buddhi determines; ahaṃkāra appropriates under I and mine; manas coordinates presentations and alternatives. Their activity gives experience continuity. An encounter leaves a trace; recollection brings the earlier affection into the present as past; imagination selects and recomposes its material into a possible course not previously experienced in that arrangement. In a sentence, earlier sounds remain active in the arrival of later ones; the final sound alone cannot speak the whole. Memory is not already a command. The instrument can carry inheritance into a new act. The Śaiva account's universal subjectward and objectward orientations also precede the ego's local appropriation: the same words, “I am this,” have different scope when *this* is the whole manifest field and when it is a particular role or possession.

[Dyczkowski's page-labelled account](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration.md) begins the differentiation with an exact demand: blue and yellow are known as different in one cognition. A wholly homogeneous light could not distinguish them; disconnected awarenesses could not hold their difference together. The field is formless in the sense that no single form confines it, and omniform in its power to bear these distinct appearances. Creative separation gives an effective world its differences without importing that world from a second reality outside consciousness. The veil belongs to manifestation's power, rather than being an alien substance thrown across an otherwise finished spectator.

Two movements pass through the field. Manifestation and withdrawal unfold diversity and gather it into unity; approach and return in perception bring a particular object into an encounter. The world-forming movement and the object-directed movement cross in each act. Will, knowledge and action give that act direction, disclosure and consequence. The finite event carries more than its visible result because it is still an expression of the power through which it occurs.

The dream carries the same pressure intimately. A sleeper does not first construct a theory of sleeping and then choose to believe the dream. While dreaming, the fact of sleep can disappear from the experienced situation. Paths lead somewhere; encounters matter; fear and desire have an immediate world. The dream's objects need not be externally material to be objective within that experience. Waking changes their relation to their condition. It does not make the experienced urgency something that never occurred.

Dissociation, tattvic contraction and the slash articulate the same event in Taylor's ontological account: a whole becomes locally inhabitable through difference whose condition can be forgotten. The dream makes that event intimate. The experienced world takes its apparent self-standing reality from a condition absent within its horizon; recognition returns that condition to the world whose urgency it sustained.

The crystal makes a different limit visible. A polished surface can display a landscape without knowing that display. Dyczkowski's p.70 contrast would leave luminous appearing unknown to anyone if reflexive awareness were absent. Adding another reflection to the crystal cannot by itself supply that missing office. The first difference is between a displayed image and the self-apprehension through which an appearance is known. The second concerns its original: an ordinary mirror receives something exterior, whereas the Śaiva mirror of consciousness generates and hosts its appearances. Neither multiplying reflections nor finding an object outside a particular optical frame explains away these two operations. The living mirror bears a differentiated world and knows it in one act.

<a id="maya-frame-usurpation"></a>
## #2

The second forgetting begins when a finite measure loses its relation to being finite. The frame now calls its own boundary the horizon of reality. What it cannot admit is redescribed as unreal, irrelevant or already explained. The operation that once made a situation intelligible becomes the authority by which every subsequent situation must be judged.

This changes the eye's encounter with another person. Before the person can answer, the frame supplies a role, score, diagnosis or expected motive. Their words become further evidence of what the frame already knew. The account's success at arranging a world conceals the conditions under which it arranged it. A determination claims its determining power; `x` acts as `X`, the reflected image as its source, the local `1` as the `0` on which it depends. Constitutive limitation has become usurped jurisdiction.

Psychically, a complex can make this arrest durable. An image attracts investment, investment colours what can be perceived, and the changed perception confirms the image. Its organisation is an achievement with a history, yet the organised basin now treats its own criterion as necessity. The forgotten field includes rejected alternatives, bodily and affective conditions, other agencies and other lives. Individuation must return those relations to the local centre while preserving the capacity that centre achieved.

The nested simulation relay gives the image an outward consequence. A model describes a situation; action based on its result changes the situation; another model then receives the changed world. The relay continues through simulations of simulations and counter-simulations. A description has entered the field it describes. The membrane between model and consequence becomes permeable.

In [Bratton's Agentworld](../../../../episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md), p.25, §§5.1–5.3, descriptive correspondence, predictive anticipation and speculative exploration have different temporal tasks. The Matryoshka image figures nested relays, including collaboration and adversarial modelling; no Russian folktale is being retold. Within [simulation's consequential relay](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/simulation.md), the model's reference, gauge, exclusions and permissions remain available where its output becomes a condition of further action.

Recurrence alone does not make the relay captive. A result can become a new condition while carrying its provenance and remaining revisable. Capture begins when the result erases its status as result and circulates as self-originating authority. More iterations then repeat the closure. In the technical relay, a representation enters an institution's causal operation and helps form what can next be encountered. In the sleeper, the condition of an experienced world disappears from that world's horizon. Each follows the produced world's capacity to conceal the relation through which it is produced.

<a id="maya-regard-refraction"></a>
## #3

The Other interrupts. A reply refuses the role prepared for it; an encounter changes which question deserves to be asked. Regard begins when this excess can alter the measure of the encounter. Attention becomes answerable. The person still judges and acts, but the criterion can now be questioned by what it concerns.

[Watson's Buddhist–psychotherapeutic conversation](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness.md#passages) passes through Gans's reception of Levinas: difference is made available to egoic need, while the face-to-face exceeds the image held of the Other. A changed economy of desire is involved. Ethical excess cannot be represented adequately as a stronger quantity on an unchanged scale of power. The Other can reveal that the scale itself has mistaken what matters. Listening then changes more than the answer selected under the old scale; it can change the question, the purpose and the terms on which an answer will count.

Context weaves the newly available relations. One view meets a counterview; their conditions become legible through their difference. Taylor's 180°→360° movement names the change from a perspective enclosing its world to perspectives and their transitions being held in context. Another angle discloses an occlusion and carries an occlusion of its own. Context holds their difference and the passage between them. [Gebser's contextual transparency](../../../../episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md) releases a perspective's exclusive validity while retaining its achievement. Taylor's contextual amplification makes the passage among views part of what becomes visible; its 180°→360° notation has its own native derivation.

The stained window lets this change be seen. Light passes through panes whose material, angle, density and colour alter what reaches the room. Lead seams hold the construction together while marking its divisions. As sun, pane, room and viewer change, the coloured projection changes. A later view reveals what an earlier arrangement withheld. The seams preserve the difference between sources, translations, histories and modes of evidence. They are part of the apparatus that makes comparison possible.

The window gives each relation a distinct office. Bimba is Original order; QL is the full ordered spectrum immanent to the light; MEF is the refractive operation of declared media, angles, transformations and exclusions; pratibimba is the situated projection. The cast picture is not the originating light, and QL is not reduced to the lead frame. Recognition proceeds through exact differences among the projections towards the order they disclose. The Original is prior in being and later in recognition.

Within a declared Context Frame, however, an achieved image can genuinely become a local original for subsequent readings. It then occupies Bimba locally while remaining pratibimba relative to its wider sources. This reference has authority enough for comparison and error to be determinate. Returned experience can revise the local reference itself. The distinction prevents two losses: installation of a produced artifact as metaphysically Original, and denial that any finite reference can govern responsibly.

Holographic refraction gives the local unit a further office. The whole descent can be carried through one unit because that unit retains its relations to condition, articulation, contraction, manifestation and return. Re-entering the unit opens those relations again; accumulating disconnected miniatures would not do this work. The whole-bearing organisation is native to the authored field. Optical holography and Bohm's implicate order remain independent source and technical questions; the image neither supplies an optics experiment nor turns every fragment into exhaustive information about a physical whole.

<a id="maya-native-archetypal-field"></a>
## #4

The whole's [native articulation](../../../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy.md) is `/ = −/− → 0/1 → ?/! → −/+ → X/x → AM/IS → ∞/dx → 1/0`. Its [eight determinations](../../../../matheme/ql/eight-determinations.md) hold the parent and returning turns around the six-position body. The six narrative turns unfold this whole relation while keeping the eight determinations and their distinct qualitative and processual placements intact.

The parent relation precedes a determinate view; `0/1` carries conscious circumstance and the inseparable identity/difference through which it appears. `?/!` brings the question and its assertion into that circumstance. `−/+` makes reserve and issue effective: something is withheld as something is put forward. `X/x` keeps determining capacity distinct from its local determination. `AM/IS` makes the situation personed, where I and what can be said of me meet an addressing You. `∞/dx` gives a local act exactness within an inexhaustible horizon. `1/0` returns its achieved determination towards the condition that never became its possession. The finite act remains; the direction of its belonging changes.

Across the [Neumann image-field](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-world-parent-separation), archetypal structuration gives this complete relation a mythic body. Taylor's eightfold reading carries En-Soph and tohu-bohu at `−/−`, world-parent separation at `0/1`, coming to light at `?/!`, hunger and its systole/diastole at `−/+`, ego against unconscious ground at `X/x`, the “I am” recognition at `AM/IS`, the great round's Mono/Poly fullness at `∞/dx`, and descent and return at `1/0`. The eight relations traverse the whole image-field. Neumann supplies the transmitted images and their psychological development; the native notation supplies this different, complete relation through which they are re-read. Their particular histories remain part of what each image brings.

Recognition's priority is decisive. In Taylor's reading of the Bṛhadāraṇyaka passage transmitted by Neumann at p.105, recognition precedes separation into husband and wife. Its “I am” therefore cannot be reduced to an ego's later appropriation. The bounded position arises within recognition's field; it cannot retrospectively originate that field. The [transmitted Neumann passage and Taylor's encounter](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness.md) keep their distinct scopes. In [the returning bond](../../../archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-return-bond), recognition preserves the differentiation through which an encountered life became possible.

The toroidal appointment also has exact offices. Anuttara/Paramaśiva retains the unobjectifiable opening, the subject or kartṛ pole. Māyā is the measure-field wound around that opening, the differentiated pattern through which manifestation becomes inhabitable. Śakti's activity and joy belong to this manifestation. Calling Māyā the hole would remove its positive work and put measure in the place it cannot enclose. The authored uroboric correction preserves depth, opening and winding where a circle-picture would suppress them. The topological witness gives depth, opening and winding to the mythic relation, holding the source and its measure-field together through their difference.

Place changes its office through these crossings. Kashmir Śaiva discourse has a historically situated doctrinal geography; the eye's here and the frame's orientation are phenomenological places; a simulated environment has configured operative boundaries. Taylor's authored movement brings them into relation while retaining what each location makes possible. The selected Singh translation of 1988, Dyczkowski's 2000 reprint, Neumann's 1954 edition, Watson's thesis/book sequence and Bratton's 2026 brief belong to transmission time. Kāla contracts temporal capacity; remembering, anticipating and returning have lived temporal offices. None of these dates supplies a mythic location, and no location collapses the distinct temporal tasks.

<a id="maya-recognition-return"></a>
## #5→0

Recognition returns through the veil. The world is still differentiated, the knower still situated, the instrument still able to select and act. What had seemed self-standing is recognised through the power that makes it possible. Līlā's play has real positions and consequences. The return keeps them while releasing their claim to originate the whole. Taylor's governing compression is exact: “Līlā veils; hybris absolutises the veil; recognition sees the veil as Śakti.”

Through [Arbitration, Hybris, Regard and Anamnesis](../../../../episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD-arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis.md), an achieved measure becomes answerable to its origin and what it has excluded. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy generates the origin/unmeasurable relation; Criterion-through-Distinction gives measure; Delineation-through-Difference gives frame. Arbitration-in-Crisis bears decision and the danger of hybris. Con-text-through-Diaphaneity enables Regard; Resolution-in-Reconciliation enables Anamnesis. These are six generated relations, with their semantic flowerings, rather than twelve merged nouns or one common etymological root.

The return must become actual in the relation it has reopened. A person hears an answer which their old account could only explain away. They can record it as one more exception, or allow it to reveal that the criterion of judgment was mistaken. In the second case, the next encounter begins differently: another possibility can be noticed, another reply can count, another act can follow. The memory has become material for a renewed intention rather than evidence for the old necessity.

The same difference acquires a technical body in the model relay. A comparing agent is the local functional knower; its sources, memory, rules and tools are means; the disputed output and the alternatives it discriminates are known. Within a person's containing inquiry, this complete apparatus is itself among the means. Inspection can make the local judging centre known in a further act without enclosing the first-person condition through which the inquiry appears.

Logging an objection leaves its consequence undecided. A better source can correct the answer while a fitting fidelity criterion remains in force; a false premise can change the task; an encountered resistance can change the world-model. A faulty evaluator, withheld permission or misrepresented purpose requires the return to reach that governing condition and its actual authority. The relevant depth is the one the encounter warrants. Adequate reasons can instead preserve the condition, with the objection and reasons remaining available for the next act. A later judgment must inherit the correction or justified retention for this return to become consequential. The source or controller of an inaccessible condition remains part of the account; naming a layer does not grant power over it.

This is the story's force for [arbitration and usurped measure](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md): necessary measuring and the claim to absolute jurisdiction need different responses. The first is preserved; the second must become answerable. A [complex's local regime](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) can then recover its history, [contextual seeing](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) can change judgment, and [individuation with recognition](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) can preserve the differentiated life while changing its relation to the whole. Anamnesis keeps the recovered relation active in the judgment that follows, including the reasons for retaining or revising its conditions.

The eye's inexhaustible condition enters [faithful definition of the Subject](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) and [defined indefinability](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C01-Subject-Defined-Indefinability.md): its present seeing does not become one more object seen. The [immutable gap](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) and [formal limit](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C04-Formal-Limit.md) distinguish that condition from information merely hidden behind the eye. [Prakāśa–Vimarśa](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A05-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) and its [inseparable pair](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C13-Prakasa-Vimarsa.md) keep the living mirror's appearing and self-apprehension together. Through [tattvic genealogy](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), [operative measure](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) gives a [bounded knower](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) an effective world, articulated through its [inner instrument](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md). The [local tattvic movement](../../../../../section-rooms/01-differentiating-mind/movements/11-s0-p4-tattvic-compression.md) carries the complete descent and return through one whole-bearing unit.

[Vikalpa and Saṃkalpa](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A07-Vikalpa-Samkalpa-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) distinguish alternatives and gather a selected course; recognition restores that formative capacity. [Constitutive exclusion](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A08-Apoha-Constitutive-Exclusion.md) and [Apoha](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C18-Apoha.md) preserve what the finite distinction excludes. [Image, valuation and possession](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md), the [living symbol and idol](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C21-Living-Symbol-Idol.md), and the [protected account](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) follow the change from a source-bearing image to a defended criterion. [Context](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) and [diaphaneity](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) reopen the arrangement through its relations.

The [world-picture becoming world-atlas](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) and its [conceptual relation](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) carry that reopening into travel between views. [Bimba and pratibimba](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) preserve the achieved local reference without letting it become the ultimate Original. [Objective Internality](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) becomes effective through the dream's experienced world and the relay's constituted means, while [order of dependence](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) keeps that world from becoming a private mind's possession. [Self and Other](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) preserves the answering person; [deferential intelligence](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) and the [mirror that moves first](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) follow the reply into revision of the deciding field.

[Homology and analogy](../../../../episteme/etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD-homology-and-analogy.md) keep the crossings exact. Dream, crystal, window and simulation disclose different dependencies; their power lies in carrying those differences into the relation. Through [compassion as sensitivity to origins](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation.md), an origin can change how the next act meets what it depends upon. In [integral zero's return](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero.md), the completed view retains its exactness while returning to the zero it could never occupy.

The eye opens again. It still sees from here. A face can now answer the account prepared for it; a memory can become material for another intention; a frame can disclose the condition that its earlier certainty hid. The finite view remains precious because this is where the whole becomes encounterable. Recognition must be lived again in the next seeing.

### Source and transmission scope

Dyczkowski's page-labelled transcript gives the colour and mirror relation at pp.65–70, reflective activity, memory and the two axes at pp.71–76, and inner/outer manifestation at pp.78–81. Watson's Buddhist–psychotherapeutic conversation carries Gans's reception of Levinas into the face-to-face relation. The sleeper, window, native eightfold and their joining are Taylor's authored developments.

The speech and recognition pathway returns through Taylor's P2/P3 encounter with the [Singh/Abhinavagupta source house](../../../../episteme/sources/indian-philosophy/abhinavagupta/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana/abhinavagupta-singh-1988-paratrisika-vivarana.md). The psychological crossings return through [Aion's source house](../../../../episteme/sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2.md) and the separately transmitted Neumann world-parent relation. These routes retain the particular works, passages and encounters which each crossing brings to the whole.
